question: Related Questions Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 36306 Country: India Title: My question is that whether women are allowed in mosque at Friday for Jumuah salah Question: My question is that whether women are allowed in mosque at Friday for Jumuah salah. Is it haram or allowed? And one more question, can the birth of Prophet Muhammad (SAW) be celebrated in Islam? If there is any hadith please explain. Answer ID: 36306 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 208/208/M=1433) (1) Jumuah and jamah is not for women. It is better for women to offer salah in their homes. (2) It is not proved. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
